product.title: Key West Sandbar Safari on One of a Kind Tiki Boat

description.text: Picture yourself aboard our unique tiki boat, the Lazy Lady, cruising through the crystal-clear waters toward a secluded sandbar. The sun is shining bright, and the air is filled with the scent of salt and sunshine. As you approach the sandbar, the boat glides over shallow waters, revealing stretches of soft, white sand inviting you to explore.Once you anchor, the fun begins! Ideal for travelers basing in Key West who want a guided Florida Keys experience without coordinating boats, gear, or launch times on their own.
